description: This file defines the RangeBinary class, which extends AbstractBinary, within the Twig templating engine. It appears to handle the compilation of a range expression ('..') in Twig templates, generating PHP code to produce a range array.

classes.name: RangeBinary
classes.description: A class that compiles Twig range expressions ('..') into PHP code.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code to create a range using PHP's range() function based on the left and right nodes.

methods.name: operator
methods.description: Returns the operator symbol for range ('..').
